test_identity: test the transforms.identity function returns input unchanged for scalar and vector arrays
test_sigmoid_logit: test the transforms.sigmoid and transforms.logit functions are inverses of each other
test_signed_transforms: test the transforms.signed_logp1, signed_expm1, signed_hyperbolic, signed_parabolic, and power functions and their inverses
test_hyperbolic_sin: test the transforms.hyperbolic_sin and transforms.hyperbolic_arcsin functions are mutual inverses
test_transform_2hot: test the transforms.transform_to_2hot and transform_from_2hot functions convert scalars to two-hot vectors and back
